tinygrad-benchmarks.alt: The LLM evaluation protocol: a historical issue and pre-PR code enter an isolated, git-free offline workspace; the model patch is tested and compared with the human patch from the merged PR, held outside the workspace
tinygrad-benchmarks.caption: Source-backed diagram of the coding-evaluation protocol. Prompts omit historical answers; the runner materializes a git-free tree and evaluates candidate patches; compare-gold compares them with the private historical solution. Offline containment is a runtime requirement, not a security mechanism implemented by this drawing.
tinygrad-benchmarks.recipe: Draw the historical-PR split, isolated model workspace, acceptance tests and retrospective human-patch comparison from the committed prompt, runner and compare-gold code.
